note: The original describes only the queen and the dealate male; the head width of 1.20—1.80 mm is given as such in the original.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closely related to A. hondurensis, from which it differs in its conspicuous fontanelle, though not as large as that of A. rotundus.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: First-form queen: head dark reddish chestnut brown, wider than long (from posterior margin to base of the clypeus), densely covered with long hairs. Fontanelle a transparent, conspicuous, pear-shaped spot on the vertex. Compound eyes black, nearly circular, large and projecting, adjacent to the lateral margins of the head. Ocelli transparent, nearly oval, upper margin projecting, separated from the compound eyes by nearly their long diameter. Postclypeus pale chestnut, projecting, bilobed, twice as wide as long, covered with long hairs. Mandibles yellow, chestnut at the apex, elongate. Antennae pale yellowish brown (broken, 12 segments preserved), covered with long hairs; segment 3 short, narrow, ring-like, shorter than segments 2 and 4; segment 4 only about half as long as segment 2; gradually longer and wider toward the apex. Pronotum almost concolorous with the head (even where slightly paler, only barely so), saddle-shaped, narrower than the head, less than twice as wide as long, broadly semicircular, densely covered with long hairs. Posterior margin of meso- and metanotum shallow and angularly emarginate. Legs yellow with brown, covered with long hairs. Abdominal tergites dark chestnut brown, densely covered with long hairs; cerci indistinct. Measurements: dealate body length 6.00 mm; head length (to the apex of the labrum) 1.40 mm; left mandible length 0.70 mm; pronotum length 0.60 mm, width 1.00 mm; hind tibia length 1.40 mm; compound eye long diameter 0.27 mm; head width 1.20—1.80 mm. Type locality Rosario, Bolivia; the description is based on one dealate male and one (physogastric first-form) queen collected with workers at the type locality in October 1921 (month 10). Holotype dealate male, USNM Cat. No. 27671; morphotype the queen.
